# Prorate plan changes mid-cycle

When a customer changes plan in the middle of a billing cycle we charge the full
new price at the next renewal and never refund the unused part of the old plan.

Customers who upgrade should pay the prorated difference, and customers who downgrade
should get a credit. Annual plans are out of scope for now.
